title: Your Private Life Matters
devotional: It is easy to focus on how we appear to other people while ignoring what happens when nobody is watching. But your private choices are shaping the person you are becoming. God is not only interested in what people can see. He cares about the heart, the hidden decisions, and the direction of your life. This is not a message meant to fill you with shame. It is an invitation to live with integrity. Today, ask yourself whether your private habits are moving you closer to the person you want to become in Christ.
mind_check: What private habit or decision do you need to become more honest about before God?
body_move: Remove one private opportunity that repeatedly makes it easier for you to fall into an unhealthy habit.
spirit_move: Spend a few quiet minutes with God today. Be completely honest with Him about one area where you need His help.
way_out: When I am alone and tempted to __________, I will __________ instead.
prayer: Father, help me live with integrity when nobody else is watching. Give me courage to be honest about the areas where I need Your help. Remove shame from my heart and replace it with a desire to walk closely with You. Help my private life reflect the faith I profess publicly. Amen.
action: Write down one private habit you want to change. Then write one practical boundary you can put in place today to make that change easier.
